response.original_title: [Complaint-Guide] Swan Hellenic Cruises Complaint Escalation: Contact & Support Guide
response.overview: To escalate a complaint or issue with Swan Hellenic Cruises, call their North America customer support at +1-866-254-7549 or visit the official Swan Hellenic Contact Us page. Contact Channels North America Support: Call +1-866-254-7549 (Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST). Email Support: Send your documentation and timeline to concierge@swanhellenic.com or use their general inquiries address at enquiries@swanhellenic.com.Step-by-Step Escalation Process Report Onboard: Speak directly to Guest Services +1-866-254-7549 or a senior officer while still on the ship and request written confirmation of the issue +1-866-254-7549. Contact Direct Support: Call the support line +1-866-254-7549 and explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor, manager, or tier-two escalation agent.
